class.name: SteamModerationReceipt
class.brief_description: The terminal audit details for one reviewed game sanction or removal.
class.description: A successful receipt acknowledges Steam's recognized reply for the request. Observe game admission or profile state separately when the game needs to confirm a later effect. When a submitted request times out or observation closes, the receipt remains available and the remote outcome can remain unresolved.

method.name: get_action
method.description: Returns the exact reviewed action recorded by the policy.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the trusted AppID that scoped this action.

method.name: get_player_id
method.description: Returns the target SteamID64 resolved by the policy.

method.name: get_report_id
method.description: Returns the reviewed Valve report ID, or empty for removal.

method.name: get_duration_seconds
method.description: Returns the suspension duration in seconds, or zero otherwise.

method.name: get_audit_id
method.description: Returns the game-owned audit reference reserved before dispatch.

method.name: get_acknowledged
method.description: Returns whether a recognized Steam reply acknowledged the action.
